claims.text: As many female Hobbit names refer to flowers, Angelica is a genus of plants with medicinal, flavoring, fragrant and medicinal properties.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix F, "On Translation"

claims.text: Angelica was the daughter of Ponto II, the grand-niece three times removed of Bilbo Baggins. Though her relationship with Bilbo was more distant, she would call him "Uncle Bilbo". She was invited to Bilbo's Farewell Party in and received a round convex mirror as a gift because she obviously admired her appearance.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix C, "Baggins of Hobbiton"; J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, The Fellowship of the Ring, "A Long-expected Party"
